terms.title: Terms and Conditions
terms.introExtra: Please note the important fee refund policy and terms & conditions before enrolling for Extra Classes:
terms.introDiscovery: Please note the below important terms and conditions before enrolling for Discovery Education Add-on:
terms.discoveryTerm: Under any circumstances/conditions, fees for Discovery Education Add-on is not refundable or transferable.
terms.agree: I confirm that I have read and agree to the above-mentioned fee refund policy and terms & conditions.

extra.definition: Extra Classes are defined as doubt-clearing classes which are in addition to your complimentary classes. For example, 2 extra classes per week mean 1 complimentary doubt-clearing class + 2 extra doubt-clearing classes = 3 doubt-clearing classes per week.
extra.payInAdvance: Students have to pay in full for the Extra Classes in advance.
extra.onlineOnly: Fees will be accepted through online payment methods only.
extra.preBooked: All your Extra Classes will be pre-booked at the beginning of every month. You will be notified duly about your Extra Classes Schedule via mail.
extra.changeTimings: In case you want to change the date and/or timings of your Extra Class(s), you will have to inform {school} via mail at least 7 days in advance.
extra.nonRefundable: Under any circumstances/conditions, fee for Extra Class is non-refundable, non-transferable and non-adjustable. Absence is not valid for any compensation class or refund of fee.
extra.compensation: The class will be compensated only if it is canceled by {school}. The compensation will occur only through policies of {school}. You cannot claim a refund of fees in such cases.
extra.notifications: Students (or their parents/guardians) are responsible for regularly checking the website for any upcoming notifications. {school} will not send notifications or updates separately to students (or their parents/guardians)
extra.amend: {school} reserves the right to amend, limit or revoke any offers or terms at any time prior to purchase and accepts no responsibility for any technical issues resulting in the failure to pay.
